Life is full of small surprises. There are always many people at the city square. Leo is going to travel to London in April. In fact, fishing boats rest in the small harbour.
Leo hopes to visit London one day. Last Thursday, Leo and Anna went to the bus terminal. Leo drinks juice after doing sports. In fact, he enjoyed sticking old photos into his travel journal.
The bus terminal is one of the best places in the city. Leo thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. The weather was windy that day. For example, the ring road takes you round the city.
Leo wrote about the day in the diary. Leo's favorite animal is the panda. Leo learned a lot about science.
